newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shares of Tamura, Shinko rise on IC card hopes.
newsitem.headline: Shares of Tamura, Shinko rise on IC card hopes.

text.p: Shares of Tamura Electric Works Ltd and Shinko Electric Co Ltd rose on Monday morning, boosted by strong prospects for companies involved in the integrated circuit (IC) card business, brokers said.
Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp has said it will use the cards in its public telephone booths.
Telecommunications equipment maker Tamura Electric added 38 yen to stand at 843 by midday.

Shinko jumped 59 yen or 15.25 percent to 446. The medium sized electrical machinery maker was the largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse and also the second most heavily traded issue at 2.54 million shares.
"The market is looking for direction so it is easy for attention to focus on such hopes," one broker said.
NTT has said it will soon begin converting its public phones, which currently total 794,000, into phones that use IC Cards.
